About DCC

Electrical expertise built on experience.

Darshan Controlss Corporation is an EA Grade electrical contracting company based in Coimbatore, experienced in consulting, designing, installation of lighting and power electrification works, communication wiring and manufacture of electrical panels.

  • Government of Tamil Nadu electrical licensing
  • HT and LT installations, additions and alterations
  • Qualified engineers, skilled technicians and workforce
  • Project planning, procurement and implementation

Our commitment

Quality is our supreme aim. We focus on steady performance, preventative and proactive maintenance, and reliable project completion.

Our vision
To be the region’s most professional and respected electrical contractor and service provider.

Our mission
To be a trusted, respected and preferred brand for electrical installation across industrial, commercial, power generation, distribution and energy-utilization sectors.

What we do

End-to-end electrical services.

From consultancy and system design to installation, commissioning and support.

01 / CONSULTANCY

Consultancy & Design

  • System design and optimization
  • Preparation of drawings, technical specifications and BOQs
02 / HT & LT

HT & LT Installations

  • Substations and distribution transformers
  • VCB systems
  • LT installations, additions and alterations
03 / INDUSTRIAL

Industrial Electrification

  • Indoor and outdoor lighting
  • Factory installations and power-cable laying
04 / PANELS

Panel Erection & Commissioning

  • Panel board erection and commissioning
  • PCC, MCC, AMF and automation control panels
05 / SAFETY

Earthing & Safety Systems

  • Earthing systems
  • Stabilizer and UPS systems
  • Lightning arresters and fire safety systems
06 / POWER

Power & Generator Systems

  • Generator systems
  • Acoustic enclosures
  • Solar installations
07 / LIAISON

Approvals & Liaison Work

  • Site temporary power arrangement
  • TANGEDCO applications and load sanctions
  • CEIG drawing approvals, inspections and safety certificates
